Los Angeles-Minnesota Deal: Ruiz for Banuelos
You can focus on the negatives after being traded to a new team -- finding a new place to stay, leaving teammates and friends, having to start anew -- but one player hopes to focus on the positives. "It means I'm wanted somewhere. At least one team sees potential in me." Those were the comments heard after the <Los Angeles Angels:team#14> came to an agreement to deal 21-year old minor league CF <Jorge Ruiz:player#54694> and 19-year old minor league RHP <Kauriel Leon:player#138738> to the <Minnesota Twins:team#17> for 29-year old minor league C <David Banuelos:player#19381> earlier today. The deal is expected to be formally announced later this evening.
